content: With law shall our land be built up, and with lawlessness laid waste.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Með lögum skal land vort byggja (Brennu-Njáls saga, Ch. 70)
explanation: Spoken by the wise chieftain Njáll Þorgeirsson, this foundational northern maxim recognizes that true civilization is not erected on the sharpness of axes or the swagger of warlords, but upon an impartial framework of law and mutual covenant. When justice is compromised for personal gain or factional spite, the entire social fabric inevitably unravels.
practicalInsight: Stand firmly for fairness and institutional integrity today, even when bending the rules would offer a quick personal advantage.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your daily life or work are you tempted to excuse small compromises that erode communal trust?
